items.summary: The three siblings used their wealth and influence to lure and sexually assault women for more than a decade. Eleven of the victims spoke on Tuesday before the brothers were sentenced.

items.title: Review: Judge Questions Trump Administration’s Need to Target Noncitizen Voters
items.summary: In the legal tangle between the Justice Department and California, a federal judge on Tuesday deferred a ruling but said the government already had a remedy it could use after the election.

items.title: Review: White House Has Tight Grip Over FBI in Pursuing Trump Targets, Agent Says
items.summary: In court testimony, the agent outlined the willingness of Kash Patel, the F.B.I. director, to take orders from President Trump to investigate his perceived enemies.

items.title: Review: Robert Kaplan: Fed Can Wait Before Hiking Rates
items.summary: Goldman Sachs Vice Chairman and former Dallas Fed chief Robert Kaplan says the central bank can afford to hold off on raising rates by one meeting while continuing to assess economic indicators. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Review: Grand Jury Declines to Bring Charges Against Cassidy Hutchinson
items.summary: The rejection of the indictment was the latest extraordinary setback in President Trump’s wide-ranging campaign to go after his political opponents.

items.title: Review: Anthropic Said to Pick JPMorgan to Lead IPO’s US Retail Offering
items.summary: Anthropic PBC has tapped JPMorgan Chase & Co. to lead US sales of shares to individual investors in its potentially record-setting initial public offering, people familiar with the matter said.

items.title: Review: Flávio Bolsonaro Leaves Brazil for the U.S. After Election Defeat
items.summary: The U.S. plans to issue a visa to Mr. Bolsonaro, a U.S. official said. Brazilian police had asked him to hand over his passports because of his links to an investigation.

items.title: Review: Tennessee Race Is Rattled by a Republican’s Acknowledgment of a ‘Past Indiscretion’
items.summary: State Senator Brent Taylor, the Republican nominee for a U.S. House seat, responded to a Nashville outlet’s report that he had sent “an unsolicited nude picture.”

items.title: Review: India Jewelers Hold Off Gold Buying, Betting Prices Will Drop
items.summary: Indian jewelers are holding back gold purchases ahead of their busiest demand season, betting that a recent drop in prices has further to run, according to the country’s biggest precious metals refiner.

items.title: Review: SK Hynix Posts Record Profit Amid AI Rush
items.summary: SK Hynix posted a stronger-than-expected seven-fold surge in quarterly profit and unveiled an additional shareholder return program for 2026 worth 100 trillion won ($75 billion), underscoring relentless demand for AI hardware. Counterpoint Research Director MS Hwang puts the results in the context of broader industry trends. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Review: Justice Dept. Steps Up Moves on Comey and Others as Midterm Elections Near
items.summary: In some cases, court paperwork bears unmistakable signs of urgency — typos, unorthodox tactics and the signatures of the department’s senior political leadership.

items.title: Review: Climate change is a 'global health emergency,' new report says
items.summary: Many detrimental health indicators linked to climate change are moving in the wrong direction, the report's authors said.

items.title: Review: U.S. Defends Military Campaign Against Cartels as Leaders Gather in Caribbean
items.summary: A regional coalition convened as part of a U.S. military effort to disrupt and combat drug traffickers that officials have compared to the campaign against the Islamic State and Al Qaeda.

items.title: Review: China Stock Premium Over Hong Kong Widens on State Intervention
items.summary: Beijing’s efforts to stabilize its equity markets are helping drive the pricing gap between dual-listed stocks in China and Hong Kong to the widest level in nearly 17 months.
